title.zh: 报道称中国间谍与英伟达CEO黄仁勋关系密切，美方调查针对黄仁勋的间谍行动
title.en: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO

current_state.zh: A report alleges that a Chinese woman accused of espionage had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, raising national-security and US-China tech-policy questions around the AI chipmaker.
